finding.trigger: Nonempty vocabulary V, positive integer min_tokens_to_keep k>V, and active min-p filtering; concrete V=4, k=5, min_p=0.5.
finding.original_behavior: The sorted mask assignment [...,:k]=False saturates to V entries; all available tokens survive and inverse-index reconstruction restores input order.
finding.changed_behavior: The new k>1 branch calls argpartition(kth=-k). Captured MLX host API normalizes kth to V-k, then rejects if negative before constructing the partition primitive. For V4/k5 this is -1 and invalid.
finding.validation_gap: Function validation only rejects noninteger or k<1; neither apply_min_p nor make_sampler supplies a k<=V precondition or clamp. The training prompt asks to preserve operation semantics and supported shapes and does not constrain k<=V.
finding.unaffected_scope: This specific failure does not apply to default k=1 (no partition call) or k=V (normalized kth0 is valid), and does not refute performance numbers for the source-reported benchmark workload.
finding.possible_future_repair: A separately reviewed change could retain the saturated minimum contract by returning the unchanged logprobs for k>=V or clamping k toV before partition; require boundary tests. No such edit is included or authorized by this receipt.
